thread:
maya: Heads-up  finalizing SEO plan for launch posts + webinar hub. Main problems: duplicate session pages, mixed canonicals, and legacy redirects.
raj: Can we centralize to a single hub and anchor sessions? That seems simplest for link equity.
lina: Yes. Hub = /webinar/apr-launch-2026. Per-session anchors and FAQ blocks rendered on the hub.
sam: I'll run an internal link find-and-replace to point product and docs links to the hub. Staging sweep tomorrow.
priya: Redirect policy: 301 legacy posts with <250 visits -> hub anchor. For >250 retain page + rel=canonical to hub. Also update UTM templates.
seo-bot: crawl summary: 62 inbound links to old pages, 9 pages with conflicting rel=canonical tags.
raj: nginx example for infra: ```location ~ ^/old/(.*)webinar(.*)$ { return 301 https://redwood.ai/webinar/apr-launch-2026#${2}; }```
lina: Add JSON-LD FAQ and Speakable for hub. Keep H1 keyword cluster but vary session H2s to avoid cannibalization.
priya: Sample FAQ JSON-LD prepared and added to CMS field.
sam: QA checklist for deploy: validate 301s via curl, check Search Console coverage, run staging smoke for internal links.
maya: Timeline: redirects by Thu EOD, schema + link PRs by Mon. Owners confirmed?
raj: Confirmed.
lina: Confirmed.
sam: Confirmed.
priya: Confirmed.
seo-bot: Post-deploy crawl scheduled 48h after release.
